english.title: Ride in the front passenger seat of a motor vehicle being driven on a road whilst not wearing a seat belt
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) rode in the front seat of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), whilst not wearing an adult belt in conformity with regulation 5(1)(b) of the Motor Vehicles (Wearing of Seat Belts) Regulations 1993.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 14(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 2(4) for meaning of 'adult belt'.
(ii) Regulation 5(1) does not apply to a person under the age of 14 years - see offence wording H121.
(iii) Be aware that a a fine cannot be registered against a 14 or 15 year old offender in their home court if they fail to pay the fixed penalty. In these circumstances it may be advisable for officers to report for summons in the traditional way and allow the youth court system to determine how the matter is to be dealt with.
